arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made on a card whose type is prepaid debit, meaning the 'Debit (Prepaid)' card type.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit cards' is taken to mean card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' only, not plain 'Debit' cards.
The rule flags all transactions on those cards in the whole data range, regardless of transaction type, amount or errors.
